description.value:
If there is a species justified to be in love with their own voice, those are the Nightingales. There is no one, in all Vesteria, who can realistically compete with their beautiful singing, and these Pici know it well. Aware of their own value in the best of cases, arrogant in the worst, the Nightingales do not need external reassurances to confirm their talent, which they do not hesitate to exploit professionally. It is very rare to find Nightingales who have not made singing their main occupation, and even rarer to find one who does not sing at all, not even for pleasure. Despite their objective qualities, however, we should not think that the Nightingales are resting on the laurels that nature has prepared for them: perfectionists, genuinely in love with music and always looking for ways to improve themselves, the Nightingales work hard for their art. Negative criticisms do not touch them particularly, but they are deeply wounded if their listeners are indifferent or insensitive.

Increase in Ability Scores. Your Dexterity score increases by 2 and your Charisma score increases by 1.

Age. A Pici reaches maturity around the age of 14 and is immediately considered independent. They have an average lifespan of around 60 years.

Speed. Your base speed on the ground is 20 feet, and your flight speed is 30 feet.

Size. A Nightingale can reach a maximum height of 2 1/2 feet, and weigh no more than 45 lbs.  Your size is  Small.

True singer. You have proficiency in the Performance skill and in the use of your voice, which is considered a musical instrument, and are considered to have expertise with regards to any singing based skill checks.
